notes: The San Francisco Call's Saturday Real Estate and Financial Section for the whole of 1910, re-read for what the two earlier 1910 batches (sn85066387-1910-real-estate, sn85066387-1910-h2-real-estate) left out: building contracts, permits, loans and building news naming only a private owner, and the brokers' sales of buildings, where the record gives a corner or an offset and a lot size (#407). 162 OCR pages over 53 Saturdays from curiv_jenner_ver01, curiv_klamath_ver01, curiv_mecca_ver01 and curiv_needles_ver01: every page either batch cites, the head page and the two after it, and every page between. Each numbered, corner or offset passage carrying a lot size was checked against both earlier files and left out where either already holds it. Private owners, buyers, sellers, lessors, lessees and borrowers are cut from address_as_written and raw (raw.note says where); contractors, architects, lenders, brokers and firms are kept. Every entry carries extra.record_date (1910 is after the 1909 renumbering). Corner and offset entries were placed with research/tools/corner.py --batch, which measures each lot's frontage from the block's end on the sf-parcels shapes: a placement needs the record's lot area within 4%, its offset within 4 feet of a lot line, the stated side of the street and a roll year that fits the record (within two years for construction, no later than 1911 for a sale).
